boiler.title: About Frankencoin
boiler.text: Frankencoin (ZCHF) is a decentralized stablecoin that tracks the Swiss franc. It is issued by smart contracts against on-chain collateral rather than by a company, has been live since 2023 and is available on eight blockchains. Frankencoin Shares (FCS) represent the protocol's equity. The Frankencoin Association in Switzerland supports its development.
boiler.note: Reuse as is or shorten; please do not describe ZCHF as bank-issued or as backed by bank deposits.
